headline_claim: CCI approves acquisition of controlling stakes in EMSH (Rajasthan Royals) by Westview Cricket Limited (~75%) and Poonawalla Sports (~18%)
Four-player mega trade: Liam Livingstone (Rs 6 Cr revised) & Jack Edwards (Rs 3 Cr) to CSK; Khaleel Ahmed (Rs 4.8 Cr) & Nathan Ellis (Rs 2 Cr) to SRH
Completed Marquee Swaps: Hardik Pandya (MI->PBKS @ Rs 18 Cr) for Arshdeep Singh (PBKS->MI @ Rs 18 Cr); Pant (LSG->DC @ Rs 15 Cr) for Kuldeep (DC->LSG @ Rs 13.5 Cr); Natarajan to SRH
IPL 2027 Timeline: Retention deadline extended to November 17, 2026; Mini-auction scheduled for December 16, 2026 in Goa
RR-LSG Trade Discussions: Negotiation discussions around Mohammed Shami and Sam Curran; Jaiswal-to-LSG trade speculation has officially stalled/dropped
RR Performance Audit: League-best PP run rate (11.67) and 181 sixes, but overs 7-11 scoring dropped to 9.07 and bowling leaked 9.71 RPO (second-worst)
